limitations: Historical DeepSeek first-party reference rates; actual anonymous route prices/expiry unknown.
Same-route append label is structural evidence not actual cache key. Gap survival descriptive conditional on previous high hit, no causal extrapolation to delayed requests.

Replay shifts observed sequential requests by same delay to next offpeak boundary, holds future token counts and gaps fixed, excludes UTC day crossing. First request only loss, later observed cache assumed restored. Not actual customer scheduling or latency valuation.
All anchor results overlap; first per session-day is a sensitivity, not independent account observations.
Full loss, partial loss and expected loss probabilities are scenarios. Fixed internal peak accounting implies no time discount; reference debit not real money.
